_doc: Style tuning for vehicles/TrickSystem.js (AD-23, CAP-13); the maths is vehicles/trickCore.js. `tricks`: base points of one trick = points + perAir * airtime s + perSweet * balanced manual s + perStep * stairs steps + perMeter * grind metres (+ bonus). `combo`: a chain keeps going while tricks follow within `window` seconds (the timer stands still while the rider is airborne, grinding or in a manual); every trick grows the multiplier by `growth` (x the character's trickMultiplier perk); a trick unlike the last two scores x(1 + varietyPoints) and grows x(1 + varietyGrowth), the same trick twice in a row scores x repeatPoints and grows x repeatGrowth; the multiplier stops at `multMax`; `fireMult` is where the fire trail starts. `bank`: a chain is worth round(points x multiplier); it pays floor(value x centsPerPoint) cents (wallet.earn 'trick') and floor(value x xpPerPoint) XP, but a chain below `minValue` fades without a payout or a `style:banked` event. A bail (wall hit, caught, manual meter failing with a multiplier of at least `bailMinMult`) banks only `bailShare` of the value, a bail of a smaller chain banks all of it. `grind` (capture = extra px around the rail's own width where an airborne rider is caught, angle tolerance in degrees, entry speed range px/s, spark interval s and count, jump-off bonus points, offCool = seconds a rail just jumped off ignores the rider, descent = the last share of an ollie in which it can land on a rail), `stairs` (rolling down without an ollie: target speed factor, extra deceleration px/s2 down to a floor px/s, only while rolling faster than rattleMinSpeed px/s, jitter px, dust interval s; the speed needed for the jump and the angle tolerance in degrees; `rattleToast` s between comic rattle texts), `ramp` (needs speed px/s and an angle tolerance in degrees; airtime = base + perHeight x ramp height, longer when fast like the ollie; the fake lift is height x liftScale px). `bankSpot` (a `bank-spot` map object): rolling through its ring (radius in tiles) on the ground, not in a manual, at most maxSpeed px/s, with a chain worth at least bank.minValue banks it cleanly with `bonus` (a share) more points, reason 'bank-spot'. `bench` is the grindable edge of a bench object: inset px at both ends and its capture width px.
